_comment: Finalized in Phase 1 (Data Architecture). Values below are placeholders reflecting confirmed decisions in GDD §31.

initialLostLoot.rule: one value-2 card from each of the 9 non-Gold-Coin types, plus one Gold Coin value-4 card

assets._comment: Controls how card/UI icons resolve. See data/iconMap.json and js/iconManager.js. Switching 'emoji' -> 'image' requires editing data only, never code (data-driven rule, GDD §2.3).
